summary: Full **Contractacions** CRM (`board` & `admin` only): CRUD `/api/v1/contracts`, `advance` state shortcut, `create-event` (accepting fallback `date` in body when `performanceDate` is null), `summary` with Diputació catalog tracking (`n / DIPU_CATALOG_LIMIT`), and web Kanban + sortable table UI with 6th-Dipu confirmation dialog. **Server + web (wasmJs)**.
overview:
Fase 2 slice for managing performances, Diputació catalog bookings, grants, exchanges, and neighbourhood parties from first contact to payment.

**Source of truth:** `docs/especificacion-tecnica.md` v1.3 §4.4, §5.7, §6.7 (contrataciones), §7.4 (Contractacions), §10.1–10.2 · `docs/decisiones.md`.

**Prerequisites**
- `platform-schema-v02` (`contracts`, `events`), `platform-core-contract` (`Contract*`, `MoneyCents`, `PatchField`), `platform-server-auth`, `platform-web-shell`, `platform-openapi-deploy`.
- `spec-03-calendar` (`EventService` reused by `POST /api/v1/contracts/{id}/create-event`).

**Key business rules (§5.7 & `decisiones.md`)**
- **Strictly `board` and `admin` only** (`anonymous` → 401; `member` and `technical` → 403 on every `/contracts*` endpoint; never exposed in `/public/*`).
- **State progression:** normal pipeline `to_contact → contacted → proposal_sent → negotiating → confirmed → done → invoiced → paid`. Direct jumps forward/backward or to `discarded` allowed via `PATCH`. Transitioning to `invoiced` auto-fills `billing.invoicedAt = today (Europe/Madrid)` if missing; transitioning to `paid` auto-fills `billing.paidAt = today` if missing; transitioning to `discarded` requires non-blank `discardReason` (`422`).
- **`POST /api/v1/contracts/{id}/advance`:** requires `{"version": N}` (`409 version_conflict` on mismatch), advances to the next normal state (applying `invoicedAt`/`paidAt` auto-fill), and rejects already-final states (`paid`, `discarded`) with `422 validation_failed`.
- **Overdue calculation:** `overdue = (nextActionAt != null && nextActionAt < today(Europe/Madrid) && status !in {paid, discarded} && !archived)`.
- **Diputació catalog tracking (`GET /api/v1/contracts/summary?year=`):** counts non-archived `type = dipu_catalog` contracts whose reference year (`performanceDate` in Madrid TZ, falling back to `updatedAt` if null) equals `year` (default current year): `total` = non-discarded count, `confirmed` = status in `{confirmed, done, invoiced, paid}`, `limit = EnvConfig.dipuCatalogLimit` (default 5). Server **never blocks** exceeding `limit`; webapp prompts confirmation before confirming or advancing into `confirmed` when `confirmed >= limit`.
- **`POST /api/v1/contracts/{id}/create-event` (`decisiones.md`):** if `eventId != null` → `409 already_exists`. Uses `contract.performanceDate` as `Event.date`; if `performanceDate == null`, requires `date` (and optional `endDate`, `allDay`) in the request JSON body (otherwise `422 validation_failed`). Creates an `Event` (`name = contract.title`, `category = actuacio`, `type = actuacio`, `status = confirmed` if contract is `confirmed`+ else `planned`, `published = false`, `locationName = client.municipality`, `address = client.address`, `ownerId = contract.ownerId`) and sets `contract.eventId` + bumps `contract.version` in one transaction, returning `{contract, event}`.
- **Archiving:** `DELETE /api/v1/contracts/{id}` sets `archived = true` (`204`); `?hard=true` is allowed for `admin` only (`403` for `board`).

**Acceptance (slice)**
- `./gradlew :server:test :app:shared:jvmTest :app:webApp:compileKotlinWasmJs` passes.
- Permission matrix test verifies `anonymous` (401), `member` (403), `technical` (403), `board` (200/201/204, 403 on `?hard=true`), `admin` (full + `?hard=true`).
- Summary calculations (`confirmedIncome`, `openCount`, `openAmount`, `pendingPaymentAmount`, `overdueCount`, `dipuCatalog`, `byStatus`) verified in `:server:test`.
- `create-event` works with `performanceDate`, requires `date` in body when `performanceDate == null`, and returns `409 already_exists` on second call.
- Web UI at `/contractacions` shows summary banner with Dipu `n/5` progress bar, Kanban board with `→` advance buttons, sortable table toggle, full detail/edit form (with `grant` section only when `type = grant`), Dipu overflow confirmation dialog, and «Crea l'esdeveniment al calendari» action.
- `OpenApiRouteSyncTest` passes.
shared_ui_policy: All UI, ViewModels, and repositories live in `:app:shared` `commonMain`. `:app:webApp` hosts wasm only. Android/desktop/JS out of v1 scope.
out_of_scope:
- Public API exposure (contracts are strictly internal).
- External invoicing / PDF invoice generation.
- Inventory (`spec-04-inventory`) and automatic notifications.
- Android, desktop, JS, iOS clients.

components.name: Contracts.sq
components.usage: SQLDelight queries for filtered/paginated/sorted contract listing (`type`, `status` list, `ownerId`, `overdue`, `archived`, `year`, `q`), summary aggregation, optimistic-locked updates, and archive/hard-delete.
components.notes: Amounts stored in `INTEGER` cents and mapped to `MoneyCents`.

components.name: ContractService
components.usage: CRUD, state transition rules (`invoicedAt`/`paidAt` auto-fill, `discardReason` requirement, `grant` allowed only when `type = grant`), `advance`, `createEvent` (calling `EventService` inside one transaction), `summary(year)`, and archive/hard-delete.

components.name: ContractsRepository + ContractsViewModel
components.usage: Manages filters (`type`, `ownerId`, `year`, `overdueOnly`, `archived`, `q`), Kanban/Table view mode, summary state, Dipu confirmation gating before `confirmed`, `createEvent` date prompt when `performanceDate == null`, and `409` conflict recovery.

components.name: ContractsScreen + ContractEditDrawer + NewContractModal
components.usage: Routes `/contractacions` and `/contractacions/{id}` matching mockups: `SectionHeader` + `+ NOVA CONTRACTACIÓ`, `KpiFilterStrip` (5 clickable filter cards: `Ingressos confirmats`, `Obertes`, `Pendent de cobrament`, `Catàleg Dipu n/limit` with progress bar, `Atrasada` cream/red), `Tauler` / `Taula` segmented toggle + filters, Kanban board with `→` advance & overdue red highlight, sortable table view, right-side `Edita la contractació` drawer (`Informació bàsica`, `Client i contacte`, import/IVA, `Subvenció` when `type = grant`, `Facturació`, «Crea l'esdeveniment al calendari», sticky `Cancel·la` / `DESA`), and centered `Nova contractació` modal using real contract fields.

structure:
Vertical slice flow:

```text
Web /contractacions & /contractacions/{id}
  → ContractsViewModel → ContractsRepository → MuixerangaApi
  ↕ JSON over HTTPS (Bearer, board/admin only)
Server ContractRoutes → ContractService (+ EventService) → Contracts.sq (SQLite v0.2)
```

Summary metrics (`GET /api/v1/contracts/summary?year=YYYY`, non-archived contracts of that year):
- `confirmedIncome`: sum of `amount` (`MoneyCents`) for `status ∈ {confirmed, done, invoiced, paid}`
- `openCount` / `openAmount`: count & sum of `amount` for `status ∈ {to_contact, contacted, proposal_sent, negotiating}`
- `pendingPaymentAmount`: sum of `amount` for `status ∈ {done, invoiced}`
- `overdueCount`: count where `overdue == true`
- `dipuCatalog`: `{confirmed, limit, total}`
- `byStatus`: map of `ContractStatus -> {count, amount}`

sections.title: Filters, sorting & pagination (§6.2 & §6.7)
sections.description: `GET /api/v1/contracts` supports `page`, `perPage`, `type`, `status` (comma-separated list), `ownerId`, `overdue` (bool), `archived` (default `false`), `year` (matches `performanceDate` year or `updatedAt` year when `performanceDate` is null), `q` (case-insensitive search in `title`, `client_name`, `client_municipality`), and `sort` (`updatedAt`, `performanceDate`, `nextActionAt`, `amount`, `title`; default `-updatedAt`).
sections.behavior: Validate sort field names strictly against an allowlist (`400 invalid_parameter` on unknown fields); never concatenate user input into SQL.

sections.title: Diputació limit confirmation & create-event flow
sections.description: When the user creates, edits, or clicks `→` advance to set a `dipu_catalog` contract to `confirmed` (or later) and `summary.dipuCatalog.confirmed >= summary.dipuCatalog.limit`, the UI displays a confirmation dialog in Valencian before sending the mutation.
sections.behavior: When clicking «Crea l'esdeveniment al calendari», if `contract.performanceDate != null`, call `POST /contracts/{id}/create-event` directly; if `null`, open a modal requesting `date` (required) + optional `endDate`/`allDay` and submit them in the request body. On success, display the link to the newly created calendar event.

endpoints.name: Contracts summary
endpoints.notes: `board`/`admin`. Optional `?year=YYYY` (defaults to current year in `Europe/Madrid`). Includes `dipuCatalog` and `byStatus`.

endpoints.name: Advance contract status
endpoints.notes: `board`/`admin`. Body `{"version": N}`. Moves to next normal status; `422` if `paid` or `discarded`.

endpoints.name: Create linked calendar event
endpoints.notes: `board`/`admin`. Optional body `{"date", "endDate"?, "allDay"?}` required when `performanceDate` is null. Returns `{contract, event}`; `409 already_exists` if already linked.

persistence: Uses SQLite v0.2 `contracts` and `events` tables via `Contracts.sq`. No new migrations.
